paths.comps: LiquidFlashCards Designs canvas (Glass Momentum app / iPad / Mac / widgets / Vision Pro)

tokens.name: accent
tokens.usage: The brand hue: plum by day and pink by night in Plum; ink blue, pine or clay in the other palettes. Goal ring, today markers, links, selected tab, due badges, icon tiles' glyphs, text links like "All decks". As text it reads on glassFieldBase, canvasBG and glass cards. As text 4.5:1 or more on the bare field, glows and glass in every theme.

tokens.name: accentDeep
tokens.usage: Hover / pressed state of accent links (the comps' a:hover). A named palette colour, not an AppColors token.

tokens.name: textOnAccent
tokens.usage: Text and glyphs on accent and ctaFill: white on plum by day, deep plum on the pink by night. Never literal white in Night.

tokens.name: accentMuted
tokens.usage: accent at 18%: selected chips and quiet selected states.

tokens.name: canvasBG
tokens.usage: Solid screen canvas where no glass field is drawn; also the launch screen colour.

tokens.name: contentSheetBG
tokens.usage: Solid sheet background (legacy content sheet; system sheets on iOS 26 use their own glass).

tokens.name: listCardBG
tokens.usage: Solid card: what every glass card becomes with Reduce Transparency on, and raisedCardBG.

tokens.name: textPrimary
tokens.usage: Titles, row titles, card faces, figures. On glassFieldBase, canvasBG, listCardBG and glass cards.

tokens.name: textSecondary
tokens.usage: Subtitles, units ("/ 20 cards"), dates, section labels, inactive tab labels, axis labels. Reads 4.5:1 or more on the bare field with each glow at full strength, on glass and on listCardBG, in every theme (LFC-167).

tokens.name: chipBG
tokens.usage: Neutral chip fill (legacy streak badge, filters).

tokens.name: chipSelectedBG
tokens.usage: Selected chip fill.

tokens.name: controlPrimaryTint
tokens.usage: Neutral control tint (steppers, unselected control fills).

tokens.name: controlSecondaryTint
tokens.usage: Plum wash behind secondary buttons on solid grounds, accent label on top.

tokens.name: destructive
tokens.usage: Delete, validation errors (field outline and message), Again. The comps' and the widget's red by day. Pair with an icon or word, never colour alone. 4.5:1 or more on glass cards in every theme (LFC-167).

tokens.name: success
tokens.usage: Success and the Review phase; Good rating fill.

tokens.name: warning
tokens.usage: Due and relearning phases, the legacy streak flame.

tokens.name: ratingAgain
tokens.usage: Again rating: solid dot or fill (Mac, visionOS).

tokens.name: ratingHard
tokens.usage: Hard rating: solid dot or fill.

tokens.name: ratingGood
tokens.usage: Good rating: solid dot or fill.

tokens.name: ratingEasy
tokens.usage: Easy rating. Must never equal recallAccent: palettes map the two differently (ADR 0009).

tokens.name: ratingAgainTint
tokens.usage: Tinted glass behind the Again button and Again status pills (30% day, 16% night).

tokens.name: ratingHardTint
tokens.usage: Tinted glass behind the Hard button and pills.

tokens.name: ratingGoodTint
tokens.usage: Tinted glass behind the Good button and pills.

tokens.name: ratingEasyTint
tokens.usage: Tinted glass behind the Easy button and pills.

tokens.name: ratingAgainInk
tokens.usage: Again label on ratingAgainTint (dark ink by day, pale by night).

tokens.name: ratingHardInk
tokens.usage: Hard label on ratingHardTint.

tokens.name: ratingGoodInk
tokens.usage: Good label on ratingGoodTint (4.5:1 or more on the tint over glass).

tokens.name: ratingEasyInk
tokens.usage: Easy label on ratingEasyTint.

tokens.name: phaseNew
tokens.usage: Card phase pill: New.

tokens.name: phaseLearning
tokens.usage: Card phase pill: Learning.

tokens.name: phaseReview
tokens.usage: Card phase pill: Review.

tokens.name: phaseDue
tokens.usage: Card phase pill: Due.

tokens.name: phaseRelearning
tokens.usage: Card phase pill: Relearning.

tokens.name: buttonPrimaryBG
tokens.usage: Solid primary button fill where no ctaFill capsule is used (badges, legacy).

tokens.name: buttonPrimaryText
tokens.usage: Label on buttonPrimaryBG and ctaFill.

tokens.name: glassFieldBase
tokens.usage: GlassField base: the colour under every iOS screen, with three glows on top.

tokens.name: glassGlowA
tokens.usage: Field glow top-leading (blush / faint aubergine), radius 55% of the long side.

tokens.name: glassGlowB
tokens.usage: Field glow trailing at 32% (lilac / indigo), radius 50%.

tokens.name: glassGlowC
tokens.usage: Field glow bottom-leading (peach / wine), radius 60%.

tokens.name: glassFill
tokens.usage: Frosted card fill over ultraThinMaterial: a milky lift by day, a 4.5% lift by night.

tokens.name: glassEdge
tokens.usage: 1px inner edge of glass cards and capsules.

tokens.name: glassShadow
tokens.usage: Glass card shadow colour (radius 15, y 10): soft plum by day, none by night.

tokens.name: glassHairline
tokens.usage: Hairline between rows of a glass group, and the card-face divider.

tokens.name: ringTrack
tokens.usage: Unfilled ring and progress tracks; icon tile and selected-tab fills.

tokens.name: recallAccent
tokens.usage: Recall: the inner ring, "This week" recall label, memory-strength charts. The only second hue. 4.5:1 or more as text on glass cards in every theme (LFC-167).

tokens.name: recallTrack
tokens.usage: Unfilled recall ring.

tokens.name: forecastDim
tokens.usage: Future forecast bars and the dashed future-day marker.

tokens.name: ctaFill
tokens.usage: Primary capsule fill: plum at 90% by day, a quieter pink by night. Label textOnAccent.

tokens.name: ctaShadow
tokens.usage: Primary capsule and FAB shadow (radius 12, y 10) by day; none by night.

tokens.name: heatmapTileBG
tokens.usage: Empty heatmap tile.

tokens.name: gaugeTrack
tokens.usage: Legacy header wave-gauge track (pre-Glass Momentum header cards; still used by the gauge).

styles.name: greeting-title
styles.usage: Title under an eyebrow line (Home: "Hi, Ihor" under the date), kerning -0.4.

styles.name: card-question
styles.usage: Study card Side A: the question. Line height 1.15, kerning -0.4.
styles.sample: Which bone is the longest in the human body?

styles.name: card-answer
styles.usage: Study card Side B: the answer.

styles.name: largeTitle
styles.usage: Font.app(.largeTitle). Sizes mirror iOS text styles at Large Dynamic Type; line heights are Apple's defaults.

styles.name: headline
styles.usage: Font.app(.headline): semibold by default; navigation bar titles.

styles.name: body
styles.sample: The thigh bone, about a quarter of your height.

styles.name: callout
styles.usage: Font.app(.callout); units after figures use callout medium.

styles.name: caption
styles.usage: Font.app(.caption): week-strip day letters, forecast labels.

styles.name: row-title
styles.usage: Deck and card row title (ListRowMetrics, iOS).

styles.name: side-label
styles.usage: Card face label "SIDE A" / "SIDE B": uppercase, tracking 1.2.

styles.name: cta-label
styles.sample: Review 8 more to hit your goal

styles.name: cta-secondary-label
styles.usage: Secondary capsule label; also rating button labels.

styles.name: link
styles.usage: Inline accent links and the "or study all 362 due" line.

styles.name: eyebrow
styles.usage: Date line above the Home title.

styles.name: chip
styles.usage: StreakChip and segmented tabs (selected bold, others semibold).

tokens.name: screenHorizontalPadding
tokens.usage: Screen gutter on iPhone/iPad (Glass Momentum). visionOS 24, macOS 16.

tokens.name: rowContentPadding
tokens.usage: Horizontal padding inside glass groups and rows; settings row inset.

tokens.name: rowHStackSpacing
tokens.usage: Gap between a row's tile, text and trailing ring/badge; gap between stacked glass cards.

tokens.name: rowVerticalPadding
tokens.usage: Top/bottom padding of a row inside a glass group (comps).

tokens.name: rowTextStackSpacing
tokens.usage: Gap between a row's title and subtitle.

tokens.name: listRowVerticalInset
tokens.usage: Vertical inset around glass rows in a List (gap between rows = 12).

tokens.name: glassGroupVerticalPadding
tokens.usage: Top/bottom padding of a GlassGroup card.

tokens.name: ratingBarSpacing
tokens.usage: Gap between the four rating buttons.

tokens.name: heroCardPadding
tokens.usage: Padding of the Home momentum card and ring-to-figures gap.

tokens.name: studyCardPadding
tokens.usage: Padding inside the study card.

tokens.name: sectionGap
tokens.usage: Space above a section label (comps: 18–20).

tokens.name: minTapTarget
tokens.usage: Minimum hit area for every control (HIG).

tokens.name: ctaHeight
tokens.usage: Primary capsule height.

tokens.name: ctaSecondaryHeight
tokens.usage: Secondary capsule height.

tokens.name: sheetBarButtonHeight
tokens.usage: Cancel / confirm pills in GlassSheetBar.

tokens.name: ratingButtonHeight
tokens.usage: Rating button height (Mac 52).

tokens.name: glassCircleSize
tokens.usage: GlassCircleButton diameter.

tokens.name: fabSize
tokens.usage: Floating add button diameter (iOS; 56 elsewhere); also the search tab button in the comps.

tokens.name: iconTileSize
tokens.usage: Deck / settings icon tile; glyph 22 (deck) or 47% (SF Symbol).

tokens.name: emptyIconTileSize
tokens.usage: Icon tile in GlassEmptyStateCard.

tokens.name: miniRingSize
tokens.usage: Deck mastery ring in rows, 4px stroke.

tokens.name: momentumRingSize
tokens.usage: Home goal/recall rings: outer stroke 11.3%, inner 8%.

tokens.name: weekMarkerSize
tokens.usage: Week-strip day marker.

tokens.name: forecastBarWidth
tokens.usage: Forecast bar width; max height 70.

tokens.name: regularContentMaxWidth
tokens.usage: Reading column in regular width (Mac, some iPad pages).

tokens.name: studyCardMaxWidth
tokens.usage: Study card max width in regular width (visionOS 820).

tokens.name: deckGridItemMinWidth
tokens.usage: Minimum tile width for adaptive deck/card grids.

tokens.name: radius-card
tokens.usage: glassCard() default: forecast card, week strip.

tokens.name: radius-hero
tokens.usage: Home momentum card and GlassEmptyStateCard.

tokens.name: radius-group
tokens.usage: GlassGroup (grouped rows) and rating buttons.

tokens.name: radius-study
tokens.usage: Study card and the card stacked behind it.

tokens.name: radius-field
tokens.usage: GlassTextField, StreakChip, sheet-bar pills.

tokens.name: radius-control
tokens.usage: Segmented filter track, glass circle (half of 44).

tokens.name: radius-tabbar
tokens.usage: Floating glass tab bar (comps).

tokens.name: radius-tile
tokens.usage: Icon tile at 38 (scales size × 12/38) and due badge.

tokens.name: radius-bar
tokens.usage: Forecast bars.

tokens.name: radius-key
tokens.usage: Keyboard hint chip on a CTA.

tokens.name: radius-pill
tokens.usage: Capsules: CTAs, segmented selection, badges, tab selection.

tokens.name: radius-mac-panel
tokens.usage: Mac: panels, cards and rating buttons (window corners 22, panels inset 8).

tokens.name: radius-mac-window
tokens.usage: Mac: standard macOS 26 window corner.

tokens.name: shadow-glass
tokens.usage: Glass cards and secondary capsules: soft plum lift by day; by night no drop shadow, only a faint inner top edge.

tokens.name: shadow-cta
tokens.usage: Primary capsule and floating add button by day; none by night.

tokens.name: shadow-mac-card
tokens.usage: Mac cards (radius 3, y 1): barely there.

tokens.name: opacity-disabled
tokens.usage: Disabled CTA, capsule or sheet confirm.

tokens.name: opacity-press-dim
tokens.usage: Press feedback with Reduce Motion on (instead of the 0.97 scale).

tokens.name: opacity-glass-press
tokens.usage: Glass circle / sheet-bar buttons while pressed (with a 0.94 scale).

tokens.name: opacity-stack-behind
tokens.usage: The card peeking behind the study card.

tokens.name: blur-glass
tokens.usage: Backdrop blur standing in for ultraThinMaterial in web renditions (comps: 22 by day, 24 by night).
